text:
Anna (Sales): Hi team — Medivue POC kickoff. They want clinical note summarization + retrieval for triage. Need sandbox with sample patient notes (PHI redacted) and an eval prompt set. Also have a security questionnaire pending and a pricing question from procurement. Timeline: demo in 2 weeks. Can we scope success criteria and owners for redaction/storage/connectivity?

Jordan (Solutions Eng): We can stand up a sandbox bucket + synthetic dataset. For hosted POC: pre-redact client-provided samples and host in short-lived S3 with presigned URLs. For Private trial, we'll coordinate VPC peering or Private deployment. I can draft eval prompts for summarization QA and retrieval recall.

Marta (Security): From security side we need: the completed security questionnaire, data flow diagram, and a redaction proof. Prefer deterministic PII scrub + manual QA. Retention policy must be 30 days or less, and all stored data encrypted with KMS. Share sample schema (fields and formats).

Liam (Platform): Connectivity options: 1) Hosted sandboxes — S3 + restricted IAM roles, no network peering needed. 2) Private (VPC) — requires network engineering contact and firewall rules. 3) On-prem — needs infra lead and offline install. For quick turn-around, hosted sandbox is fastest.

Anna (Sales): Procurement asked if the POC is covered by trial credits or if they need to commit to a short Dedicated dev seat. Medivue headcount for POC: 3 engineers for evaluation. Jordan — any rough cost estimate for a 2-week eval (approx 4k requests/day, mixed gen + embeds)?

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Rough back-of-envelope: ~40 GPU-hours if we use a small group and batching; if they want lower latency Dedicated it bumps up. I'll run model/cost sims and share numbers. Also propose pass/fail criteria: 1) summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.25 on clinical prompts, 2) retrieval Recall@10 >= 0.7, 3) < 5% hallucination on audit set.

Marta (Security): If they're shipping any production-ish data, legal wants a data processing addendum. For the sandbox we accept redacted samples only. Please confirm Medivue security contact.

Liam (Platform): Quick sample redaction helper we recommend (for initial scrub):
```
# python example: simple PHI redactor
import re

PII_PATTERNS = [r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b",  # SSN
                r"\b\d{5}\b",              # ZIP
                r"([A-Z][a-z]+\s[A-Z][a-z]+)"] # names (naive)

def redact(text):
    for p in PII_PATTERNS:
        text = re.sub(p, "[REDACTED]", text)
    return text
```

Anna (Sales): Owners: Jordan -> infra + cost estimate + eval harness; Marta -> security signoff and questionnaire; Liam -> sandbox provisioning. Can we get a checklist and timeline?

Jordan (Solutions Eng): I'll post a Confluence checklist and cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Will include: sample dataset (synthetic + client-redacted), eval prompts, infra runbook, and playbook for rolling to Private if needed.

Marta (Security): I'll start the security questionnaire and reach out to Medivue's security lead. Need to confirm they accept redaction-only samples and the KMS key name if they want CMK.

ops-bot: Reminder created ticket POC-4821 assigned to Jordan (Solutions Eng) for sandbox provisioning.

Anna (Sales): Thanks all — looping in Medivue SRE + security now. Will update with customer contacts. :thumbsup:
